100: You've been signed in with a temporary profile.
101: There was a problem with your roaming profile. You've been signed in with your previously saved local profile. Please see the event log for details or contact your administrator.
102: You can't access your files, and files created in this profile will be deleted when you sign out. To fix this, sign out and try signing in later.  Please see the event log for details or contact your system administrator.
103: You've been signed in with the default profile for the system. Please see the event log for details or contact your administrator.
104: You've been signed in with a local profile because cross-forest roaming profiles are disabled. Changes made to this profile won't be synced with your roaming profile. See the event log for details or contact your administrator.
105: Your roaming profile isn't synchronized completely with the server. You've been signed in with a partially synchronized profile. Please see the event log for details or contact your administrator.
106: Your roaming profile isn't synchronized with the server because a slow network connection is detected. You've been signed in with a local profile.
200: Your roaming user profile was not completely synchronized. See the event log for details or contact administrator.
301: This service is responsible for loading and unloading user profiles. If this service is stopped or disabled, users will no longer be able to successfully sign in or sign out, apps might have problems getting to users' data, and components registered to receive profile event notifications won't receive them.
501: This task will automatically upload a roaming user profile's registry hive to its network location.
